items.title: Air Experience Flying
items.description: Fly in a Grob Tutor aircraft with a qualified pilot - available to all cadets.

items.title: Summer Camps
items.description: Annual week-long camp at an RAF station. One of the highlights of the cadet year.

items.title: National Competitions
items.description: Represent 2312 at wing, regional and national competitions in shooting, drill, sports and more.

items.title: Duke of Edinburgh Award
items.description: Complete your Bronze, Silver or Gold Duke of Edinburgh Award through the squadron.

items.title: BTEC Qualifications
items.description: Gain a nationally recognised BTEC in Aviation Studies or Public Services.

items.title: Cadet Ranks
items.description: Progress from Cadet through to Cadet Warrant Officer, developing leadership at every step.
